fields.statusCode: The `statusCode` which provides the codified meaning of a specific event. While the `statusCategory` and `statusCode` may be empty on non-significant events, the `statusMilestone` will be provided on each and every event of a shipment.
fields.statusCategory: The `statusCategory` which provides the codified category of a specific event.
fields.statusMilestone: The `statusMilestone` which provides the overall status of the shipment at the time of the event. The field `statusMilestone` is provided both at event-level (overall status of the shipment during the occurrence of the event) and at shipment-level (overall status of the shipment at the present time).

milestones.label: Info. Received
milestones.description: The shipment has been declared electronically and/or is in preparation by the shipper.

milestones.label: In Transit
milestones.description: The shipment has been accepted or picked up from the shipper and is on the way.

milestones.label: Out for Delivery
milestones.description: The shipment is about to be delivered, usually the same day.

milestones.label: Failed Attempt
milestones.description: A delivery attempt was made and failed (Recipient not available, business closed, etc.)

milestones.label: To Pick Up
milestones.description: The shipment is ready to be picked up by the receiver. (At a pickup point such as a post office, a locker, or a local business)

milestones.label: Delivered
milestones.description: The shipment has been delivered. (Delivered at home, picked up from a pickup point, etc.)

milestones.label: Exception
milestones.description: The shipment can’t be delivered due to issues that seem to be final (Returning, returned, lost, destroyed, etc.)

milestones.label: Pending
milestones.description: The shipment doesn’t have events available yet or can’t be found.

categories.description: Events related to data exchange, without physical meaning.

statusCodes.description: Delivery order created. The delivery order is electronically declared in the courier's system.
Delivery order cancelled. The delivery order has been cancelled in the courier's system.
Final delivery methods and/or time slots have been proposed to the receiver and the courier is waiting for his feedback.
Final delivery methods and/or time slots has been decided (by courier, sender, receiver or unknown).
Shipment picked-up or received by the carrier.
Shipment departed from origin country. (in case of an international shipment)

categories.description: Event related to the arrival at the destination country.

statusCodes.description: Shipment arrived in the destination country.

categories.description: Event related to the customs clearance.

statusCodes.description: Shipment received by/Presented to the customs.
Exception or delay during customs clearance. Additional documents or payment may be required.
Shipment rejected by customs.
Shipment cleared by customs.

categories.description: Event related to the delivery phase.

statusCodes.description: Shipment available for pickup at a pick-up point or at the Post Office.
Shipment delivery in progress.
Delivery attempted and unsuccessful. Usually, the delivery will be tried again the next day, or the shipment will be left at a pick-up point.
Issue during delivery or preventing delivery, which usually could be solved.
Shipment refused by the recipient.
Shipment has been delivered.

categories.description: Event related to an exception/issue which is usually final.

statusCodes.description: Shipment undeliverable, will be or being returned.
Shipment lost by the carrier.
Shipment destroyed by the carrier.

sampleTrackingNumbers.note: You can reuse the same sample multiple times by modifying the last three characters of the sample to any three-digit combination (e.g., `SHIP24_SAMPLE_DELIVERED_000`, `SHIP24_SAMPLE_DELIVERED_123`, `SHIP24_SAMPLE_DELIVERED_888`). This will effectively create a new Tracker, with tracking results remaining the same as the version ending with `000`. Alternatively, if you want to recreate a tracker with the exact same tracking number, you can do it by providing a unique `clientTrackerId` for each new Tracker.
